decisions.reason: As a large established machinery firm with R&D and slack in a growing market, it is likely to retain this core-adjacent coolant pressure booster system because it remained on the website through 2024, suggesting results at least met aspiration levels.

This coolant cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's established coolant-management business and, having stayed marketed through 2024, likely appears satisfactory enough relative to aspirations to keep rather than reallocate resources.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's existing offer and still visible in 2024, so despite some chance of later portfolio simplification the firm's size, broad range and acceptable observed survival point to retention.

The hinged belt chip conveyor also survived the initial review period and fits the firm's material-flow portfolio, so behavioral-theory logic suggests keeping it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration, which current evidence does not indicate.
